intro.sr: Administrator zakazuje termin za klijenta koji je zvao telefonom: usluga, varijanta, terapeut, vreme i podaci.
intro.en: An administrator books an appointment for a client who phoned: service, variant, therapist, time and details.

admin-termini-klik-na-dodaj.sr: {Kliknemo} „Novi termin (ručno)“. Koristi se kad klijent zove telefonom ili dođe bez zakazivanja.
admin-termini-klik-na-dodaj.en: We {click} “Novi termin (ručno)”. It is used when a client phones in or walks in without booking.

rucno-usluga.sr: Biramo uslugu, pa varijantu. Varijante se pojave tek kad izaberemo uslugu.
rucno-usluga.en: We choose the service, then the variant. Variants only appear once a service is chosen.

rucno-terapeut.sr: Biramo terapeuta koji izvodi uslugu. Može i bez izbora, pa termin ostaje nedodeljen.
rucno-terapeut.en: We choose the therapist who performs the service. It can be left empty, and the appointment stays unassigned.

rucno-vreme.en: We enter the date and start time.

rucno-klijent.sr: Upisujemo podatke klijenta. Za postojećeg korisnika možemo da ga izaberemo iz liste umesto da kucamo.
rucno-klijent.en: We enter the client's details. For an existing user we can pick them from the list instead of typing.

rucno-napomena.sr: Napomena je opciona, ovde samo beležimo kako je termin zakazan.
rucno-napomena.en: The note is optional; here we just record how the appointment was booked.

rucno-cuvanje.sr: {Kliknemo} „Kreiraj termin“. Ručni termin nema ograničenje najave od sat vremena. Cenu možemo i ručno da podesimo, na primer za nagradnu igru.
rucno-cuvanje.en: We {click} “Kreiraj termin”. A manual appointment is not bound by the one-hour lead time. We can also set the price by hand, for example for a giveaway.
